entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I recently purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. Before we proceed, can I get your order number? And just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
The order number is VF886-1029. And it's definitely a fit issue. I took them on one ride and they gave me some really nasty blisters on my heels. The sizing just feels wrong for my foot.

I'm very sorry to hear that; that's not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see you received the cycling shoes 6 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy, so we can absolutely process a full refund for you.

A full refund is great, thank you. Now, I have a proposition. I've already installed my cleats on them. It's a hassle to take them off. How about you provide a 50% refund, and I'll just keep the shoes? It saves you return shipping and restocking.

I appreciate the offer, but our system is set up to process a full return for a full refund to ensure you're completely satisfied with your gear. We can't issue a partial credit for you to keep the item. You can send them back with the cleats attached, that's not a problem at all.

Okay, I see. Fair enough. In that case, since I am going through the trouble of sending them back and will need to order a different pair, could you provide a discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 10 or 15 percent?

I understand you want to find the right fit with us, and we appreciate that. Unfortunately, I'm not authorized to generate one-off discount codes for a standard return. However, once your refund is processed, you'll be all set to purchase a new pair, and you can apply any of the active promotions we have on our website.
Alright, David. I had to try. The full refund is what's most important. Let's proceed with that. What do I need to do?

Excellent. I have just initiated the return process. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
Perfect, that's easy enough. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
